S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

symptom.disease_info: Persistent Depressive Disorder is a chronic depressive condition defined by a persistently depressed mood lasting at least two years in adults, accompanied by associated changes such as appetite or weight disturbance, sleep disturbance, low energy, and functional impairment. Its course is typically steady and long-running rather than episodic, which distinguishes it from a single time-limited major depressive episode, though symptoms can still become clinically significant and impairing.

patient.stressor: Two years and four months ago, Nikeita stopped community-college coursework after financial pressure and shift demands made it impossible to continue while working as a quality assurance inspector, a setback that felt especially sharp because she had tied school to her plan for senior QA leadership. The first changes were easy for her to dismiss as disappointment, but the low mood, appetite and sleep disruption, and persistent fatigue settled into her daily routine and followed her from the production floor to basketball, dance nights, church STEM mentoring, and home. Over time the impairment became severe: she lost momentum in nearly every role that had anchored her identity, received warnings for inconsistent work attendance and documentation delays, and stopped pursuing the short road trips and group activities that had kept her connected. She came to psychiatric care after a workplace referral through the employee assistance program, prompted by concern that the long-lasting decline was putting both her job and future training plans at risk.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: I’m here because for the last couple years I just feel low all the time, like even when I’m at work or church or around people I care about, there’s this heavy empty feeling that doesn’t really lift.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.
S026.manifestation: Most days I either skip eating until my shift is almost over because nothing sounds good, or I end up grabbing vending machine snacks late just because I’m drained, and my weight has been up and down enough that my work pants fit different from month to month.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: I’ll be exhausted after standing on the production floor all day, but when I get in bed my mind keeps running about everything I’m behind on, and if I do fall asleep I wake up feeling like I barely rested.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: Even small stuff like filling out inspection logs, driving to basketball, or washing my hair feels like it takes more energy than I have, and resting on my days off doesn’t really refill me.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: I’ve gotten written warnings at work because I’m missing shifts and turning in inspection documentation late, and I’ve mostly stopped showing up for basketball, dance nights, and the church STEM mentoring I used to care about.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about two years and four months, since I had to stop taking community-college classes because of money and my work schedule.
